mapper.select: WITH hnsw_config AS ( SELECT set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'relaxed_order', true), set_config('hnsw.ef_search', #{efSearch}::text, true) ) SELECT qe.*, 1 - (qe.embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding}::vector) AS similarity FROM kb_qa_embedding qe, hnsw_config INNER JOIN kb_qa_pair qp ON qe.qa_pair_id = qp.id WHERE qp.library_id = #{libraryId} ORDER BY qe.embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding}::vector LIMIT #{topK}
